items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I met Tom Holmes and his wife Vivian on a ship, and he hung out with my wife and — I hung out with them.

ctx.x: Oh that’s right, I read that. The only guy in history.

He was the only guy to do that. I met Tom Holmes and his wife Vivian on a ship, and he hung out with my wife and — I hung out with them. He played in one of those — he saw one of those games, and he says this guy was just wild enough to keep you off the plate so you couldn’t dig in against him you know. You son of a — crazy guy on the mound. And he was just wild enough and with enough control that these two games in a row, one against the Braves and one against the Dodgers, that he pitched two no-hitters in a row…
